body: Third hero shipped from the batched next-wave entry. One of the traditional Eight Immortals, subsists on mother-of-pearl and moonlight. Full kit: passive HP regen, Q a heal-off-a-fraction bolt (Bacon+Puck's mechanic, repeatable), W a free-toggle second regen layer, R a heal-only zone with no enemy damage (mirror of Vassago's silence-only R). ARENA_HERO_COUNT 23->24. 5 new tests, full suite (337 checks), VS0/VS1 stable. Verified live: a real match drafted 20 distinct heroes with zero duplicates, He Xiangu included. Commit 941949b.
title: He Xiangu, 24th hero -- third from the batched hero-wave (S170-93)
